description: 加入网络's 扫码 on a phone (docs/IOS.md 第三步): khor's own page may ask the camera for a pairing ticket's QR code, and nothing else of the scanner. Five commands, each one the flow uses: check and request the camera permission, scan (windowed — the page draws its own way out), cancel that scan, and open the system's settings for khor when the permission was refused, so a refusal ends in a sentence with somewhere to go. Not vibrate, not the plugin's `default` set. Phone builds only: the plugin does not exist on a desktop, and neither does this grant.
